text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The world is celebrating Christmas. But with preparations for the Senior year underway, we have no time for such festivities...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Trainer, you're off today too?
choice_data_list: Yeah. For some reason, I have one day open.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I don't have anything going on either.
Things wrapped up early or got rescheduled, so it worked out nicely.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Could this possibly be...
a present from Santa Claus!?"
choice_data_list: Given the timing, it's certainly possible.
Given the timing, it's certainly possible.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Since you went through the trouble of getting me a present.
Why don't we go make the most of Christmas together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, to enjoy Christmas to the fullest, the two of us headed out to the Christmas market.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
For now, I checked the website beforehand and planned out
a route so we can enjoy the market to the fullest!
choice_data_list: Thanks for going out of your way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, since we have this rare opportunity,
let's enjoy Christmas to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: After all, it's a special present that Santa gave to us♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"There are so many Christmas knick-knacks.
I wonder which one would look good in your room, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Who, me? Well, let's see...
Ah, that snow globe over there is really cute!
choice_data_list: Well then, how about we get matching ones?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Thank you so much.
Let's both take good care of them!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think decorating the Christmas tree
is the most fun part?
choice_data_list: Hanging up the star decorations was so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean! I couldn't reach when I was little,
and I ended up crying out of frustration once.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well, in terms of aiming for victories,
that hasn't changed even now, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We've looked around everywhere, haven't we?
All that's left is to head home and return to our daily routine—

text_block_list.name: Market Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ah, customer, I forgot to give you your lottery ticket.
They're holding a Christmas lottery over in the plaza,
so please feel free to try it out if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?
Well then, why don't we test our luck
to wrap up Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Attendant
text_block_list.text:
Grand prizeーー!!
It's a ticket to reserve the Furlong Tower observation deck for a private event!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Grand prize!? Yahoo!!
We did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Could this be...
a present from Santa Claus too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right. Does that mean we should
enjoy Christmas a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Are you enjoying Christmas,
Trainer?
choice_data_list: Just being together is enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fufu, same here!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I mean, isn't spending time with someone special the very essence of Christmas?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
To me, Trainer, you are someone
irreplaceable and truly precious.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That was what I had planned for today,
but...
I guess nobody can compete with Santa!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I am enjoying Christmas to the absolute fullest!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...If possible, I'd love to come again next year!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I hope I get a present from Santa
like I did this year, though...
choice_data_list: Shall we write a letter to Santa?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Sounds interesting! In that case... what language would it be?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, I'll study hard and try writing a letter! So that we can spend every Christmas like this from now on."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Though having said that, I don't really have time over the New Year holidays with race prep and events.
choice_data_list: I'll do my best to make time!
I'll do my best to make some time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then I can't let myself lose either.
I'll work briskly to make some time!
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Let's enjoy Christmas to the fullest next year too!
